note: ADR-D-004 (C3) mcp/ <-> cli/ Layer-1 sanctioned-exception registry (D004-W5 data-file; task 362-012, 361-014 debt). WHAT THIS IS (honest framing): a REGISTRY-SCOPED ratchet, not a full mcp/-wide C3-edge scan. scripts/lint-layer-shims.mjs derives the set of governed files from this file's `shims[].from` values and verifies each governed file's cli/-crossing imports are all covered by a registered entry (same `to` module + symbols subset-of-allowed) -- 'no registry entry, no import' per ADR-D-004 C5. A brand-new mcp/ file that starts importing cli/ is NOT auto-discovered by this mechanism; extending to a full-edge, all-files scan is ADR-D-004's own documented D004-W6 (hard graph gate + full-edge scan), separate future work. `enforced: false` entries are recorded for context/precedent only (the pre-existing ADR-G-011 Surface-Parity/CLI-MCP-parity convention, broadly used elsewhere in mcp/tools/*.ts) and are not the crossing this ratchet actively protects; `enforced: true` entries are the crossing type this task's gate exists for. `expiry` is mandatory on every entry.
